selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-worker runs as a managed service under the dedicated inventorysvc account
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the dedicated account, enabled and active unit, correct ExecStart/User/Group settings, and live process UID/GID 999 matching inventorysvc.
Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, current-boot systemd startup log, and recovered enabled/active worker running as inventorysvc.

commands.command: if getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then echo 'inventorysvc already exists'; else sudo useradd --system --user-group --no-create-home --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc; fi; getent passwd inventorysvc; getent group inventorysvc

sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
sudo chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
